subject: history
concept: Understanding that families have their own histories and stories worth knowing
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student shares a simple family story or tradition they know about, real or illustrative
exercise.pictorial: Student matches family role pictures (grandparent, parent, sibling) to a simple family tree
exercise.abstract: Student explains why learning about family history matters

assessment.success_marker: student engages with the concept of family history in their own words, using a real or illustrative example
